title: Associate Construction Manager
description: Official KitchenPark Greenhouse role in Riyadh for an Associate Construction Manager focused on site execution and delivery of restaurant and kitchen construction projects. The role covers contractor and consultant coordination, site inspections, HSE and quality oversight, risk and progress reporting, review of submittals and RFIs, change orders, schedules, and BOQ/costing across civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and gas scopes. The listing asks for 5-7 years of construction-management experience, including 3 years in food-and-beverage or restaurant construction, plus MEP and project-controls exposure.
